criteria.estimand: R6 = sum over the block's pairs of the best yield among the six transported conditions, divided by the sum of the best yield over the block's reference condition set. Identical in form to the manuscript's retention, but the reference set is the block's complete submatrix, not the array's full library.
criteria.why_the_reference_set_is_smaller: These pairs were measured on part of the library, so a complete submatrix of 24 to 35 conditions is the largest reference set that exists for them. Substrate classes were preferred over library depth.
criteria.not_comparable_to: The manuscript's headline retention, which uses libraries of about ninety conditions. A smaller reference set can only raise R6. The comparison that is meaningful is against control_on_analysed_pairs, computed on the same columns.

endpoints.S1_retention: R6 per block, with the analysed-pair control on the identical columns
endpoints.S2_hit_recovery: among never-read pairs whose reference-set best is at least 0.20, the share whose best within the six is at least 0.20
endpoints.S3_severe_loss: among never-read pairs whose reference-set best exceeds 0, the share losing more than 0.20 absolute yield

resolvability_rule_fixed_before_scoring.effect: A block with fewer than 8 never-read pairs reaching 0.20 is reported as UNRESOLVED and is excluded from the median and from every pooled figure. Its pair count is still reported. This rule exists because freeze 1 produced three blocks of three to four productive pairs and had no such rule.
resolvability_rule_fixed_before_scoring.floor_of_the_whole_freeze: If fewer than four blocks are resolvable, the freeze reports UNRESOLVED as a whole and no verdict is drawn.

outcomes_fixed_in_advance.supports: the median R6 over resolvable blocks is not more than 0.10 below the median of their controls, AND at least two thirds of resolvable blocks have R6 at or above 0.60
outcomes_fixed_in_advance.does_not_support: the median R6 is more than 0.10 below the median control, or fewer than two thirds of resolvable blocks reach 0.60; the manuscript then reports the shortfall and names the transformations where the panel failed
outcomes_fixed_in_advance.direction: The criterion is one-sided downward: a never-read R6 ABOVE its control is not a failure. Stated explicitly because a two-sided interval can be satisfied in the wrong direction.
